svg.text: DIAGRAM 3 — EXIT ARCHITECTURE: Ground Zero Redesign for Kraken
Exit Controller owns ALL normal exits. Emergency SL on Kraken matching engine is crash protection ONLY. No competing exit strategies.
LAYER 1a — SIGNAL-BASED EXIT
Triggers: SSS score decay below threshold
Max hold time without TP progress
Trend structure breaks (5-min or 1H)
Method: WS cancel_order(TP) + WS market sell
Exit reason: SIGNAL_DECAY | TIME_EXPIRY | MOMENTUM_LOSS
LAYER 1b — TP FILL
Resting TP limit order fills on Kraken matching engine
Exit Controller detects via executions channel (exec_type=trade)
EC immediately cancels emergSL stop order (off-book)
Fee: maker 0.16%
Exit reason: TP_FILL
LAYER 2 — MAE THRESHOLD BREACH ★ (Exit Controller — NOT Kraken)
Trigger: current_price − entry_price ≥ ATR(14) × 1.5x (CIATS-owned multiplier)
SEQUENCE CRITICAL — both cancels before market sell (prevents simultaneous Kraken SL fire):
Step 1: WS cancel_order(TP resting order) ← cancel first
Step 2: WS cancel_order(emergSL off-book stop) ← cancel second
Step 3: WS add_order(market sell, taker 0.26%) ← sell last
★ MPP RISK (C-1 dv1_4): Market sell subject to MPP — may reject if spread is wide. Exit Controller MUST handle MPP rejection and retry. Assign: 0511004.
Exit reason: MAE_THRESHOLD_BREACH
LAYER 3 — EMERGENCY BRAKE ★ (Kraken matching engine ONLY)
FIRES ONLY: VPS crash / TothBot dies / internet severed / unrecoverable WS disconnect
Off-book emergency SL stop-market order at ATR(14) × 3.0x from entry
Survives any TothBot failure independently — stored on Kraken matching engine
SHOULD NEVER FIRE IN NORMAL OPERATION — if it fires: system failure event, investigation required
★ MPP RISK (C-1 dv1_4): When stop triggers, engine fires market order. MPP enforced — may reject on wide spread. Assign: 0411001.
R:R FORMULA (Sacred — Hardcoded)
mae_pct = ATR(14) × 1.5x / entry_fill_price (CIATS-owned 1.5x)
net_loss = mae_pct + 0.16% + 0.26% (entry maker + exit taker)
net_gain = net_loss × 1.5 ← SACRED — HARDCODED
gross_target = net_gain + 0.16% (TP maker exit)
emergSL_dist = ATR×3.0x / entry_fill_price (NEVER in R:R formula)
OTO CONDITIONAL — REJECTED
batch_add on fill CONFIRMED correct.
OTO uses limit price for TP/SL calc
— not actual fill price. Violates
sacred R:R. Creates Position Mirror
race condition. Assign: 0811003.
